Class BankAccount

java.lang.Object
BankAccount
public class BankAccount extends Object
Represents a simple bank account with an owner, a balance, and an active/inactive status.

A bank account may be used to deposit funds, withdraw funds, transfer funds to another account, and close the account.

An account must have a zero balance before it can be closed. Once closed, no deposits, withdrawals, or transfers may be made.

  • Constructor Details

    • BankAccount

      public BankAccount(String owner, double initialBalance)
      Constructs a new bank account for the specified owner with the specified initial balance.

      The account is active when it is created.

      Parameters:
      owner - the name of the account owner
      initialBalance - the starting balance of the account
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the initial balance is negative

  • Method Details

    • deposit

      public void deposit(double amount)
      Deposits the specified amount into the account.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount of money to deposit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the amount is less than or equal to zero
      IllegalStateException - if the account is closed

    • withdraw

      public void withdraw(double amount)
      Withdraws the specified amount from the account.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount of money to withdraw
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the amount is less than or equal to zero
      IllegalArgumentException - if the amount exceeds the current account balance
      IllegalStateException - if the account is closed

    • transferTo

      public void transferTo(BankAccount otherAccount, double amount)
      Transfers the specified amount from this account to another account.

      The amount is withdrawn from this account and deposited into the destination account.

      Parameters:
      otherAccount - the account that will receive the funds
      amount - the amount of money to transfer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the destination account is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the amount is less than or equal to zero
      IllegalArgumentException - if the amount exceeds this account's balance
      IllegalStateException - if this account is closed
      IllegalStateException - if the destination account is closed

    • closeAccount

      public void closeAccount()
      Closes the account.

      The account may be closed only when its balance is exactly zero.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the account balance is not zero
